alignment_floor_note: Czech is 70% subtitles, so it needs more than the base floor, but its harvest is thinner than Portuguese's (mean 38.7 at 10,000 cards) and it has no machine-translation gate of its own -- Czech has no inverted punctuation to lose and diacritic-stripping fires more on Tatoeba than on subtitles, so it cannot be used. Re-measure against a scored Czech harvest before raising this.
